notes.title: Moonfall is featured in Yogcast Games' Tiny Teams Festival!
notes.content:
Yogcast Games is holding an indie festival celebrating the small teams behind great games! Join their stream from August 9th-15th (starting 8pm BST) at [url=http://twitch.tv/yogscast]http://twitch.tv/yogscast[/url]. 

I'm happy to announce that [b]Moonfall[/b] will be featured in the festival! As a solo developer, it's great to see small teams on the front stage. To celebrate, get a [b]30% discount[/b] on the game for the whole duration of the event :)
